title: Warm Peruvian Lamb Seco De Cordero
description: A malty and snappy Peruvian dish featuring vanilla sugar, perfect for a date night, with a vegan friendly alternative, this seco de cordero is a must try, the deglaze fond adds a rich flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: or vegan alternative such as jackfruit

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shoulder with vanilla sugar, garlic, and ginger.
Heat a large dutch oven over medium high heat and sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside, then add the soy sauce, red wine, and beef broth to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring the liquid to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2.5 hours, or until tender, then add the potatoes, carrots, and peas to the pot.
Continue to braise for an additional 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly, then serve the lamb and vegetables with the rich deglaze fond spooned over the top.
